lines.text: Hey, watch where you are walking!
I hate tourists.
Imagine if I just waltzed right into your home and started stomping everywhere.
Is someone going to deal with this intruder, or...?
Really? Are you incapable of keeping a respectful distance?
Who do you think you are?
You are incredibly disrespectful.
Stamp, stomp, in from the marsh!
You're welcome in the Drunken Dwarf!

lines.text: The skycutter bound for Dalaran City has just arrived. All aboard for Dalaran City!
The Skycutter bound for Mulgore has arrived! All aboard for Mulgore!
The disturbance has only grown in severity, Silva. If the citizens do not know about this-
Let's go over the findings from that pylon again, in case we missed something.
You know our orders. Until we know for sure, this is the best way to keep the city calm.
If Archmage Rhonin does not return soon then what will come of the-
Not now--we are not alone. Stay on mission.
Oh enough of that crazy talk, swimmers. You are going to scare off the few customers we have with your drunken ghost stories!
Oh, enough of that crazy talk, swimmers. You are going to scare off the few customers we have with your drunken ghost stories!
Remember me, husband, but do not let your life be consumed by revenge!
A paladin... here? How?
I need no help from the light. Begone, paladin.
I never thought I'd see the day that a paladin would be doing anything other than trying to destroy me.
I'm feeling much better, thank you.
I... thank you, paladin.
Executor Arren can do it himself next time!
Has anyone seen my weapon?
I have failed the Dark Lady. But not again.
I live to fight another day!
I need to train more.
I was in over my head!
It had to be spiders...
Thank you. I'll head back to Deathknell.
...BELATHAAN BRIGHTWISH
ONE MOMENT PLEASE. RECOGNITION. SHEN'DOREI. HIGH ORDER MAGISTER.
POWER RESTORED. READY TO RESUME FUNCTION.
